transport.rate_limit: per FSA terms; one list call per day, then per-docID downloads

parsing.notes: Two-step: list filings per day via documents.json?date=YYYY-MM-DD&type=2&Subscription-Key=KEY (401 without key), then download each docID's XBRL ZIP via /documents/{docID}?type=1&Subscription-Key=KEY. Extract financial facts from the XBRL instance using a taxonomy-aware reader (JP-GAAP vs IFRS element names differ). Currency JPY. v1 API is retired (403).

mapping_rules.financials: Map XBRL facts (NetSales, OperatingIncome, NetIncome, TotalAssets, NetAssets) per fiscal period (periodEnd) into financial_statements[].
mapping_rules.join: JCN (col results[].JCN) = 13-digit corporate number -> join to NTA. secCode -> ticker for listed issuers.
mapping_rules.document_filter: Use docTypeCode 120 (annual securities report) for full annual statements.

fixture_requirements: XBRL instance with JP-GAAP financial facts
XBRL instance with IFRS financial facts
filer with null secCode (non-listed obligated filer)

live_test_plan.smoke: With a free EDINET_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY, list one day and download one annual report's XBRL; extract net sales / net income.
live_test_plan.full: Iterate the disclosure calendar, download annual reports, extract financial facts; gate behind env.

blockers: API v2 requires a free Subscription-Key (registration with FSA); documents.json returns 401 without it.
Coverage limited to listed & disclosure-obligated companies (not non-listed SMEs).
Financial facts require a taxonomy-aware XBRL extractor (JP-GAAP/IFRS).
